hardware.gpu: AMD Radeon Pro VII 16 GB (Vega 20, gfx906); rocminfo reports the marketing name from the VBIOS
hardware.pcie_measured: 13.7-13.8 GB/s host->device (the engine's own PCIe probe at startup), i.e. PCIe 3.0 x16 throughput on this Xeon E5-2666 v3 platform
hardware.power_cap: 190 W (hwmon power1_cap = 190000000 uW, == power1_cap_default == power1_cap_max; rocm-smi --showpowercap is not available on ROCm 6.2)
hardware.cores_threads: 10 cores / 20 threads, single socket; AVX2, no AVX-512
hardware.storage: system NVMe: GLOWAY Basic256GNVMe-M.2/80 (256 GB); model shard 1 on a SATA SSD (GALAX TA1D0120A, NTFS), model shard 2 on the NVMe via a symlink
hardware.display_gpu: a separate NVIDIA GT 710 drives the monitor; the Radeon Pro VII has no display attached and was dedicated to Strata during the runs

gguf_files.verified: local sha256 == the repository's published LFS oid (queried from the Hub mirror API)
local sha256 == the repository's published LFS oid

model.note: Shard 2 is the n-gram/PLE table and is identical across all four quantizations of this release; the local copy is the same file the IQ3_S download placed on the NVMe, linked beside shard 1 under the IQ2_XS name (llama.cpp's split loader requires all shards in one directory).

artifacts.pack: built with tools/iq_pack.py --gguf <shard 1> --out <pack>; index.txt: 1079 tensors, 302 served natively, arena 1.43 GiB
